name: Sequence
description: Executes a series of output pins in order. Each output fires sequentially from a single execution input, allowing you to run multiple chains one after another without rewiring the graph.

inputs.name: In
inputs.description: Execution pin that starts the sequence. Connect any exec output here.

outputs.name: Then 0
outputs.description: First output, fires immediately after In. Connect the first chain of logic here.

outputs.name: Then 1
outputs.description: Second output, fires after Then 0 completes. Click 'Add pin' on the Sequence node to create additional Then N outputs.
